A concrete slab with sub-base costs PLN 283/m², and finishes range from PLN 78 to 492/m² excluding VAT. Installation, transport and site preparation are quoted after reviewing site photos.

Czy da się zrobić boisko na starym beton: Can a court be built on old concrete?
Zwykle tak. Jeśli beton jest stabilny, n: Usually, yes. If the concrete is stable, I repair cracks and defects, prime the substrate and apply a flexible sports coating with rubber granules, then graphics and markings. Severely damaged substrates must first be rebuilt.

Najmniejsze areny mają około 5 m średnic: The smallest arenas are approximately 5 m in diameter; a 3v3 court measures 15 × 10 m. Additional safety clearance must be allowed. Check site dimensions in the “Will it fit?” planner on the homepage.
